messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — ACME wants a trimmed, low-latency multimodal summary in beta by EOW. Can we list concrete blockers and owners?
Noah (Eng): That timeline is tight but maybe doable if runtime + infra overlap. Main eng blocker: sequence-length handling for images + text.
Priya (Runtime): Runtime needs a KV-cache tweak for mixed modality tokens; current batching assumes text-only. I can prototype a fallback but need infra to reserve a GPU pool for tests.
Jamal (Infra): I can spin a small dedicated pool (2 x A10g) for the week. Need exact resource profile: CPU, mem, gpu mem.
Priya (Runtime): For perf tests: request shape ~ [batch 8, tokens 512] + image bytes ~ 1–2MB. GPU memory peak ~18GB.
Noah (Eng): Also need an API contract for the new endpoint: input schema and error modes. Maya, can you confirm acceptance criteria from ACME?
Maya (Product): ACME wants 90thpct latency < 600ms for text-only, < 1.2s for multimodal in beta. Failure mode: degrade to text-only summary if image decode fails.
Elena (Security): Heads up — images may contain PII. We need a data retention policy + SSO access for the beta. Also request a quick threat review (48h).
Tomas (Customer Success): ACME agreed to a staged beta with 500 users and signed DPA; they can tolerate short downtime during testing window.
Noah (Eng): Can we meet the 48h threat review? If not, propose mitigations: image redaction + no persistent storage.
Elena (Security): Temporary mitigations OK: no write-to-disk, ephemeral S3 signed URLs with 1min TTL, and logging scrub for image metadata. I'll confirm checklist by EOD.
Jamal (Infra): Allocation OK. I'll provision the pool tonight and create an internal-only endpoint in staging. Command I’ll run:
```
terraform apply -var='env=staging' -var='gpu_pool=acme-beta' -auto-approve
```
Noah (Eng): For rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% across tenants. Need runtime feature flag and a kill-switch in front. Priya, can you add a fast-fail path?
Priya (Runtime): Adding kill-switch + prefix cache bypass. ETA: 1.5 days for safe rollout.
Maya (Product): Summary action items:
- Elena: threat checklist + confirmation (owner) — by EOD (security)
- Jamal: provision GPU pool + staging endpoint — tonight (infra)
- Priya: KV-cache tweak + kill-switch + perf prototype — 36h (runtime)
- Noah: API contract + canary rollout plan + tests — 48h (eng)
- Tomas: customer readiness + verification window with ACME — coordinate today (CS)
Noah (Eng): One more: telemetry hooks. Need token-level cost, p90 latency and error reasons surfaced in console.
Maya (Product): Yep include telemetry and an eval prompt set to detect quality regressions.
Tomas (Customer Success): I will schedule a 1-hour sync with ACME for tomorrow 10am PT and share acceptance test cases.
deploy-bot: New staging endpoint created: https://staging-api.redwood.internal/acme-beta (cert pinned).
Noah (Eng): OK, I’ll draft the API contract in this thread and push a short PR to the product repo.
Maya (Product): Thanks everyone — if we hit blockers, call an ad-hoc standup. :rocket:
